title: Listen to the Ant and Be in Safety
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! As-salaatu wa salaam `alaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, Rahmatan-'l-`Alameen,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s) wa alihi wa sahbihi wa `alaa Saahib al-Anbiyaa wa 'l-Mursaleen salawatullah wa
salaamu ajma`een. Ishfa` lana yaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-akhireen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
As-salaamu `alaykum! Salaam `alayna wa `alaykum wa li ‘l-mu`mineen as-salaam man `ittaba al huda.
O Our Attenders from every kind of people! As-salaamu `alaykum! Listen! Listen and keep the holy words of
holy people. Try to keep your oath that you made with Allah Almighty when He said, "Who are you, and Who
am I?" All of them said, "We are Your weak servants and You are our Creator, and our Lord, the Lord of all
Creation. You granted us endless honor by granting us to be deputies on Earth, to make everything obedient
in this world. We are accepting and giving our oath to You that we are going to obey Your holy orders that
You sent from Heavens to us on Earth. We are accepting and giving our oath that we are Your servants and
we are under Your heavenly laws and orders, and that we are going to keep them with high respect.”
That is the oath we made on the Day of Promises. Those who are not keeping their promise are the worst
Creatures on Earth!

O People! O People! We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Shaytan is always making
people to be disobedient. That is Shaytan's mission and it is running from east to west, from north to south,
and entering every place where the Children of Adam are, urging them not to be obedient ones, saying, "Don't
listen to heavenly orders, don't even believe that there are heavenly orders! You may make your own orders
and you may be lords on Earth by yourself!"
Now people everywhere are taking care to keep shaytanic advice. It is not advice, but people think that it is
freedom when Shaytan makes them to be disobedient. Everywhere people are asking for, "Freedom,
freedom." Who is teaching you that freedom? If you are going to be free through your actions, then what is
the reason for sending prophets with holy books to you? Rather, Shaytan is saying, "Freedom, freedom," and
everywhere people are asking for, “Freedom, freedom.” That is shaytanic work, to make people “free” and not
to keep heavenly orders. (Shaytan is saying,) "Don't believe. You must be free to do everything."
Now all of the 21st century’s people are running after, “Freedom, freedom, freedom.” Therefore, even Muslim
countries are refusing heavenly orders, Shari`atullah. They are saying, "We don't (want to) take care of
Shari`at! We must make our own constitution. We are doing as we like, we are free ones, and we are never
accepting something coming from Heavens," because Shaytan is saying, "Don't believe in something that
comes from Heavens, no, you must make your constitution as you like.”
Therefore, O believers from Arabs! Who ordered you to make democracy? How is it like this?
Now troubles are growing in the Islamic world, and there is one group of people who are saying, "We are not
accepting old rules that you call ‘Shari`at,’ we are not accepting that. We must make our constitution by
ourselves through ourselves, as we like." They are giving “freedom” to people, men are free, and women are
free. Rasoolullah (s) said, subhaanAllah:
Wa ’r-Rasool salawaatullah wa salaamahu `alayhi qaal: Sa-yatee zamaan yazhhar, subhaanAllah, kaasiaatin
`ariyyaat. nisaauhum yalbis thiyaab, wa laakin.
The Prophet, may peace be upon him, said, “There will come a time when ladies will appear as clothed, but
they will not wear clothes.”

Kaasiaatin `aariyyaat? Ladies are dressing in a dress but they are like naked people. Everywhere they are
mumilaatin maa’ilat, swaying and swinging, asking for that new-fashion freedom. Are you not seeing fashion
shows on that shaytanic TV? Ptuuh `alaykum, spit on them! First spit on men who are letting this happen.
Therefore, they are fighting, and saying, "We don’t like Shari`ah. There is no freedom there. We must do
everything and be free everywhere." That is freedom for them. They are asking to do every forbidden thing,
but the Lord of Heavens (swt) is saying:
•••••••••• •••••••••••• ••••••••••••
asbiroo wa saabiroo wa raabitoo, be patient in adversity, and vie in patience with one another, and be ever
ready (3:200)
"Be patient, O good people, honored people, be patient! I am leaving for them a chance to do as they like, to
make their? Don't say anything about them, leave them and look at what is going to happen."
Now Egypt, Libya, Tunis, Algeria, all of Arabia, Turks, and all people in the east and west are the same and
they doing as they like. Things are now boiling like a volcano, first fearful sounds are coming and then
“ohhhhh,” now those days are approaching. Symbolic ones in Islamic territories as well as the whole world
can't do anything. Now it is beginning and the terrible noise of volcanoes is coming. They were thinking that
their wrong way was going to continue as they liked, but, wa li-kulli naqul haad, "For everything there is a
limit," it is not going to be forever. When a thing reaches its limit, it is taken away.
Beware, all nations, all people, and give your high respect for holy orders that 124,000 prophets brought to
you from Heavens for teaching people. Shaytan is coming now, making its dirt in it and people are saying,
"Oh, this is very wonderful.” They are eating the dirt of Shaytan and saying, "So beautiful," because all of
them are drunk. If they are drunk, they cannot know if something is good or bad, or if it is sweet or not, and
all of Mankind now is drunk. If they do not come by themselves to follow holy orders of Allah Almighty, a
heavenly whip is ready to come on them. Don't think that is something that Man can prevent.
You are now hearing about floods, volcanoes, earthquakes, and you are fearing tsunamis, but people are
drunk, not thinking on it, and they are continuing on their wrong ways, and their wrong actions are making

Heavens to be angry with them. No one can be in safety. If the European continent is coming down like this
(sinking), who can stop it, your technology? What technology? Some places now are becoming like this and
this is Cyprus; they say that in the old times, in a historical period, this island came down (sank) and up again
three times, (only because) Umm Haram, bint Haram (r), Prophet's companion, who is buried here fixed it!
Alhamdulillah! However, people are not taking care and I fear another punishment may come on them.
O People! Think on it. O People! Take your care. If not, no one can save you. If a hurricane is sent on Cyprus,
from the beginning up to the end, it may take everything along with Man also. It may take them, their homes,
their animals, everything and throw it into the Mediterranean Sea. Beware, O Cypriots, Turkish or Greek, and
keep heavenly orders. If not, I am fearing (for them). If I leave, maybe something will come on them. I am
nothing but if I am going away from here, it will be a very dangerous place here. It is written on Preserved
Tablets that this island will come down, and that there will be an earthquake to take it away. If you do not
give respect for holy orders, and if you do not give rahmah to yourself, no one is going to give you mercy. May
Allah forgive us.
Today will be something special that Shari`atullah, holy orders are coming to nations one after one, asking
them to accept it. I don't know, from this Friday to the second Jum`uah which countries may be on fire.
Something must come one the heads of everyone who is kicking out holy Shari`at and they will be in regret.
That is a heavenly order. It is a heavenly system and warning from Heavens. Allah Almighty may use an ant
to warn all people as it is mentioned in the Holy Qur'an. Asta'eedhu billah.
••••••• •••••••• ••• •••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••••• ••• ••••••••••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••••• •••••• •••
•••••••••••
Qaalat namlatun yaa ayyuha 'n-namlu 'dkhuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaymaanu wa
junooduhoo wa hum la yash`uroon. One of the ants said, "O ants! Enter your homes unless Sulayman and his
armies unknowingly trample you.” (an-Naml, 27:18)
Qaalat namlatun. One ant was warning all ants, "Udkhullo masaakinakum, enter and remain in your homes!"
Therefore, there is an important point here also that is mentioned in the Holy Prophet's warning, when the
Last Day approaches, there will be so much fitna, corruption. (He is saying,)

“O my Nation! If you fear there is something happening there, the one who is sitting, not moving, is in safety.
The one who stands up, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) to look at what is happening there, is in
danger.” (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Don't stand up to look at what this is, one bullet may reach to you! Thirdly, the one who is running to look
what is there, will fall in endless troubles. They will be in danger, and they are not taking responsibility for
those people. Therefore, it is not the Islamic way to make people crowd together and shout in the roads and
public squares. That is forbidden. If you are asking to do something, get in the mosque and say, “O our Lord!
Save the weak servants from giants," and He may put the hearts of giants in fear, and they may leave
everything and run away.
Now everything is against Shari`at. Arabs know this. O Arabs! Where are you? Why are you not looking to
the holy Shari`at? What is there? Then you are crying and shouting, this is not the way! You are responsible,
leave them and come to your homes, put down your prayer rug, sit down and pray two raka`at. Allah is able
to send angels to bring fear to those people who are against Muslims and Shari`atullah and they will run
away without you coming and facing them. However, where is Islam? There are no scholars. They are also
confused about what they should do. No one knows, and they are writing and looking at hadith ash-shareef
about the days of danger for Muslims. They are not looking at what is the advice of Rasool (s); no one is doing
this and I am asking forgiveness.
Say, Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, al-`Azheem, al-`Azheem, astaghfirullahi ‘l-`Azheem wa
atoobu ilayh. Yaa Rabbee! Anta Waliyuna! Anta Mawlana! Anta Mawlana! Alhamdullahi Rabbi 'l-`Alameen.
Fatihah.
Qul, yaa mu`mineen, “HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah. HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah. HasbunAllah,

RabbunAllah.” It is enough for you to always to say, HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah,” enough. If you do not
know anything else, say, “RabbunAllah, HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah, HasbunAllah,” and it is enough.
Fatihah.
